items.title: Zurich P&C operating profit rises 16% on specialty and investment gains
items.summary: Zurich Insurance Group reported a 16% increase in Property and Casualty business operating profit for the first half of 2026, driven by specialty expansion and higher investment returns.

items.title: European insurers cap riot coverage as civil unrest surges
items.summary: Insurers across Europe are imposing coverage caps, higher deductibles and exclusions as strikes, riots and civil commotion risks increasingly behave like natural catastrophes.

items.title: Antares grows Lloyd's stamp capacity 4.7% for 2027 underwriting year
items.summary: Antares Syndicate 1274 has raised its stamp capacity to £445 million for 2027 as managing agents face growing pressure on rate adequacy.

items.title: JP Morgan Asset Management launches global value equity active UCITS ETF
items.summary: JP Morgan Asset Management has introduced an active UCITS ETF targeting attractively valued global companies with a total expense ratio of 0.55%.

items.title: Howden highlights power and backup failures as major data centre risks
items.summary: Howden reports that uninterruptible power supply failures and backup issues account for the majority of major data centre outages.

items.title: Nine in 10 mid-market UK and Ireland firms faced disruption, Chubb survey finds
items.summary: Chubb's Middle Market Risk Radar shows widespread disruption among growing businesses, though nearly one in five firms operating internationally lacks overseas insurance.
